events.title: 3,000+ Wishlists! Thank You for Your Support!
events.summary: Hello, card collectors! TCG CARD CHAOS has passed 3,000 wishlists on Steam! 🎉 It feels like we were just celebrating 2,000 wishlists, and now we’re already past 3,000. We couldn’t be happier! Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted the game, shared it with friends, and sent us their thoughts. For our small team, your support means so much. events.title: TCG Card Chaos is joining Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello everyone! TCG Card Chaos is taking part in Steam Next Fest from October 19 to 26! Step into a shop filled with scattered collectible cards and start bringing order to the chaos. Examine each card, find where it belongs, and enjoy watching the collection come together. Our free demo is already available, so you can jump in today! events.title: 2,000+ Wishlists — Thank You! 🎉
events.summary: TCG Card Chaos has passed 2,000 wishlists on Steam! 🎉 Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted the game, tried the demo, shared it with friends, or sent us feedback. Your support means a lot to our small team. We’re continuing to improve the game as we prepare for our October 27 release. If you haven’t tried it yet, check out the free demo and let us know what you think! Thank you for being part of this card-filled journey! ❤️ Odd Forge Games
